metas.name: 2026 · Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2015 · The Little Prince
metas.description: A little girl lives in a very grown-up world with her mother, who tries to prepare her for it. Her neighbor, the Aviator, introduces the girl to an extraordinary world where anything is possible, the world of the Little Prince.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Tomb Raider King
metas.description: God-like tombs surface globally, granting magical relics. Betrayed and left for dead, elite hunter Jooheon travels 15 years into the past to loot every tomb, hoard artifacts, and execute revenge.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2010 · Yogi Bear
metas.description: A documentary filmmaker travels to Jellystone Park to shoot a project and soon crosses paths with Yogi Bear, his sidekick Boo-Boo and Ranger Smith.

metas.name: 2026 · VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: 2026 · Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: After a world-shattering disaster, a young Earthbender learns she's the post-Korra Avatar. Now seen as a harbinger of doom, she and her twin race to save the Seven Havens while pursued by humans and spirits alike.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Billy the Kid
metas.description: An epic romantic adventure based on the life of Billy the Kid, from his humble Irish roots and his early days as a cowboy and gunslinger in the American frontier, to his pivotal role in the Lincoln County War and beyond.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2005 · Sahara
metas.description: Master explorer Dirk Pitt goes on the adventure of a lifetime of seeking out a lost Civil War battleship known as the "Ship of Death" in the deserts of West Africa while helping a WHO doctor being hounded by a ruthless dictator.
